tasks.description:
### 🎯 Autonomous Roadmap Proposal

> ⏳ **Status:** Proposal created by Tri-Agent Architect. Waiting for approval by @moslembabaee before development begins. Add the `approved` label or comment `/approve` to authorize this task.

**Task ID:** `T-EVOLVE-1792116220-1`
**Phase:** `Continuous Polish & Evolution`
**Planned By:** Tri-Agent Autonomous Architect
**Assigned Agent:** `CLAUDE`

#### Description & Scope
Implement automated branch creation, pull request generation, and lifecycle management triggered upon successful task verification. Populate PR metadata from roadmap task requirements, assign reviewers defined in maintainers.json, and handle automated merging when CI passes.

#### Quality Gate Verification
```bash
cd /root/projects/software-factory && npm run typecheck && npm test
```

Reference: Closes #25

## Description
Create the first database migration strictly from `docs/45_STORAGE_SCHEMA.sql`. This migration is the canonical reference for all tenant tables.

## Scope
All tables from the normative schema:
- tenants, actors, projects, works, executions, events, outbox, idempotency_keys
- agent_runs, worker_leases, approvals, external_effects, budget_ledger, artifacts
- references, relations
- Indexes: events_by_execution, execution_by_work, lease_expiry
- Extension: pgcrypto

## Migration framework
- Use a Node.js migration runner (e.g., `node-pg-migrate` or `knex migrate`)
- Migration files in `infra/migrations/` with timestamp-based naming
- Both `up` and `down` scripts for each migration step
- Append-only restrictions and RLS comment annotations included (enforcement in Phase 1)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `infra/migrations/001_initial_schema/up.sql` matches `docs/45_STORAGE_SCHEMA.sql` exactly
- [ ] `infra/migrations/001_initial_schema/down.sql` drops all created tables
- [ ] Migration runner executes `up.sql` against a fresh PostgreSQL 16 instance
- [ ] Migration runner can roll back with `down.sql`
- [ ] All UNIQUE, FOREIGN KEY, CHECK constraints present
- [ ] Indexes created
- [ ] `pgcrypto` extension enabled
- [ ] `npm run migrate:up` and `npm run migrate:down` scripts work

tasks.title: Issue #7: CI pipeline: lint, typecheck, test, and migration verify
tasks.description:
## Description
Set up GitHub Actions CI pipeline for Phase 0 that runs on every push to any branch (except docs-only changes). Must validate every project deliverable before green.

## Pipeline stages
1. **Setup**: Checkout, Node LTS, npm/pnpm install, cache restore
2. **Lint**: ESLint with TypeScript strict rules
3. **Typecheck**: `tsc --noEmit` or `tsc --build` across all packages
4. **Unit tests**: `vitest` run (placeholder passing test)
5. **Docker**: Build and start PostgreSQL 16 via compose
6. **Migration verify**: Run migrations against the composed DB, verify all tables exist, then rollback
7. **Notify**: On failure, comment on the PR/commit

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `.github/workflows/ci.yml` exists with the stages above
- [ ] Pipeline triggers on push to any branch and on PRs to `main`
- [ ] Pipeline skips docs-only changes (paths filter: `docs/**`)
- [ ] Pipeline runs and all stages pass on the current `main`
- [ ] Migration verify stage runs `npm run migrate:up && npm run migrate:down`
- [ ] Job timeout under 10 minutes for basic run

tasks.description:
## Description
Implement `packages/factory-core` with the six primitive domain model types as TypeScript types and Zod runtime validation schemas, derived from `docs/45_STORAGE_SCHEMA.sql` and `docs/06_DOMAIN_AND_STORAGE_v2.md`.

## Six primitives
- Work (id, tenantId, projectId, createdBy, objective, state, version, timestamps)
- Actor (id, tenantId, subject)
- Execution (id, tenantId, workId, parentExecutionId, state, budgetCap, reserved, spent, timestamps)
- Reference (id, tenantId, kind, targetId)
- Relation (id, tenantId, fromRef, toRef, kind)
- Event (id, tenantId, executionId, sequence, type, payload, occurredAt)

## Deliverables
- `packages/factory-core/src/primitives/` — one file per primitive
- `packages/factory-core/src/index.ts` — barrel export
- Zod schemas for runtime validation of each type
- TypeScript types inferred from Zod schemas
- Unit tests for schema validation (valid/invalid cases)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every column from storage schema has a corresponding TS type field
- [ ] Zod schemas reject invalid states (e.g., execution budget < 0)
- [ ] Union types for state enums (ExecutionState, WorkState, EventType)
- [ ] `npm run test -w packages/factory-core` passes
- [ ] `tsc --noEmit` passes

tasks.title: Add a task verification executor that runs verification_cmd and updates roadmap status
tasks.description: Implement a verifier module (verify_task.py) that executes a task's verification_cmd in the repo working directory with a hard timeout (e.g. 300s), captures stdout/stderr and exit code, and writes a verification record (timestamp, exit code, log tail) into the roadmap store. On exit code 0, transition the task to status 'verified'. On failure, transition it back to 'in_progress', increment retry_count, and append the failure log tail to the task record. Wire the verifier into orchestrator.py so tasks that an agent marks ready_for_verification are automatically picked up, and expose a `python verify_task.py <task_id>` CLI plus a dry-run flag. Preserve existing task fields untouched during the update and handle tasks with no verification_cmd by skipping verification with an explicit note.

tasks.title: Add retry-with-backoff and stale-task recovery to the orchestrator
tasks.description: Add a recovery/scheduler pass (recover_tasks.py) that scans the roadmap store for tasks stuck in 'in_progress', 'waiting_approval', or 'assigned' states past a per-state TTL (default 30 minutes, configurable). For each stale task, increment retry_count, apply exponential backoff (2^retry_count * 5 min, capped at 4h) before the next agent assignment, and transition it to 'waiting_approval' with a reason recorded. After retry_count reaches a configurable max (default 3), mark the task status as 'escalated' and post a notice listing the task id, agent, retry history, and last log tail so maintainers.json contacts can act. Emit one line per action to a structured log consumed by watchdog.sh and ensure recovery runs are idempotent (a task must not be double-incremented by concurrent runs).

tasks.title: Issue #2: Monorepo skeleton: TypeScript strict config and package structure
tasks.description:
## Description
Scaffold the monorepo skeleton per `docs/13_REPOSITORY_LAYOUT_v1.md` and `docs/35_BUILD_PLAN_AND_ACCEPTANCE.md`. Use npm workspaces (or pnpm workspaces) for package management. Enforce TypeScript strict mode across all packages.

## Directory structure
```
software-factory/
  apps/
    api/          # public API + auth (Phase 1+, scaffold now)
    workbench/    # UI (Phase 4+, scaffold now)
  packages/
    factory-core/ # six primitive domain model
    runtime/      # worker runtime (Phase 3+, scaffold now)
    flow/         # flow engine (Phase 2+, scaffold now)
    events/       # event contracts (Phase 1+, scaffold now)
    storage/      # DB access layer (Phase 1+, scaffold now)
  infra/
    migrations/   # SQL migrations (this phase)
  tests/
    contract/     # contract tests (Phase 1+, scaffold now)
    e2e/          # e2e tests (Phase 4+, scaffold now)
  docs/
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Root `package.json` with workspaces config pointing to `apps/*` and `packages/*`
- [ ] Each package dir has a `package.json` with `"private": true` and `"type": "module"`
- [ ] Root `tsconfig.json` with `strict: true`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`, `moduleResolution: "bundler"`, target `ES2022`
- [ ] Each package has its own `tsconfig.json` extending root
- [ ] `apps/api` has a minimal `src/index.ts` that exports a noop
- [ ] `packages/factory-core` has `src/index.ts` re-exporting domain types placeholder
- [ ] `docs/` dir kept pristine for spec documents
- [ ] Build succeeds: `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 across all packages

tasks.title: Issue #14: feat: Add two-way GitHub issue <-> roadmap task sync
tasks.description:
### 🎯 Autonomous Roadmap Proposal

> ⏳ **Status:** Proposal created by Tri-Agent Architect. Waiting for approval by @moslembabaee before development begins. Add the `approved` label or comment `/approve` to authorize this task.

**Task ID:** `T-EVOLVE-1792061687-3`
**Phase:** `Continuous Polish & Evolution`
**Planned By:** Tri-Agent Autonomous Architect
**Assigned Agent:** `CODEX`

#### Description & Scope
Extend webhook_server.py and issue_bot.py so that a GitHub issue labeled 'factory/task' automatically creates a roadmap task with phase inferred from label config, assignee from the issue assignee, and a bidirectional link (store issue number on the task and task id in the issue body/comment). When a linked task transitions to 'verified' or 'done', post a comment to the issue summarizing the result (commit/PR reference if present) and close it. Handle issue edits and unlabeling by reconciling the link (unlink and optionally pause the task). Keep the sync idempotent against redelivered webhooks (dedupe by issue id + event timestamp) and log every sync action so the roadmap history shows the GitHub event that triggered it.

#### Quality Gate Verification
```bash
cd /root/projects/software-factory && npm run typecheck && npm test
```

Reference: Closes #14

### 🎯 Autonomous Roadmap Proposal

> ⏳ **Status:** Proposal created by Tri-Agent Architect. Waiting for approval by @moslembabaee before development begins. Add the `approved` label or comment `/approve` to authorize this task.

**Task ID:** `T-EVOLVE-1792061687-3`
**Phase:** `Continuous Polish & Evolution`
**Planned By:** Tri-Agent Autonomous Architect
**Assigned Agent:** `CODEX`

#### Description & Scope
Extend webhook_server.py and issue_bot.py so that a GitHub issue labeled 'factory/task' automatically creates a roadmap task with phase inferred from label config, assignee from the issue assignee, and a bidirectional link (store issue number on the task and task id in the issue body/comment). When a linked task transitions to 'verified' or 'done', post a comment to the issue summarizing the result (commit/PR reference if present) and close it. Handle issue edits and unlabeling by reconciling the link (unlink and optionally pause the task). Keep the sync idempotent against redelivered webhooks (dedupe by issue id + event timestamp) and log every sync action so the roadmap history shows the GitHub event that triggered it.

#### Quality Gate Verification
```bash
cd /root/projects/software-factory && npm run typecheck && npm test
```

Reference: Closes #14
